newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline, bucking crude, tumbles to Dec values.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline, bucking crude, tumbles to Dec values.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices, bucking the sharp rally in crude and gasoline futures, tumbled on Thursday to converge to Dec swaps prices, traders said.
Eurograde barges fell about $8 to $206/$209 fob ARA, close to Dec swaps at $205.50/$206.50, they said.

After a sharp inventory-building rally ahead of the U.K. budget on November 26, barges steadily fell on fears that the tanks were full in the U.K. and stocks would reenter the market at a seasonally weak period.
"The forward market is clearly indicating the market is coming down but it not more bearish than that," a trader said.
He said the arbitrage to the U.S. appeared open based on Dec swaps values, but was closed by about $5-$6 for local prompt material.
The arbitrage, which opened in the last two weeks and sucked some cargoes to the U.S., was focusing on the Jan NYMEX contract since Dec expires next Wednesday.
"The prompt is coming down to meet December," a broker said.
Eurograde barges heard traded at $212.50, twice at $212, $210.50 and late in the day at $208, traders said.
Regular unleaded barges were still very quiet but its discount continued to narrow, to about $6 from $14 last week. Barges fell $3 to $200/$202 fob ARA.
